sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-agent workflows dominate the daily list, spanning skills, team automation, visual tooling, trading, and model routing. At the same time, local inference and practical developer education remain strong secondary themes.

sections.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd
sections.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
sections.why_notable: A sharp signal for agent UX and concise output control.

sections.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
sections.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser using real data and a photorealistic 3D globe.
sections.why_notable: Combines browser graphics with open spatial intelligence.

sections.title: obra/superpowers
sections.description: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology.
sections.why_notable: Shows sustained demand for structured agent workflows.

sections.title: alsk1992/CloddsBot
sections.description: Open-source AI trading agent spanning prediction markets, crypto venues, and EVM chains.
sections.why_notable: Pairs autonomous agents with real-time finance and execution.

sections.title: Tencent/teamai-cli
sections.why_notable: Enterprise-oriented team automation is drawing strong attention.

sections.title: AlexsJones/llmfit
sections.description: A command-line tool for finding models and providers that run on your hardware.
sections.why_notable: Local model selection remains a practical deployment problem.

sections.title: liquidslr/system-design-notes
sections.description: Notes for System Design Interview - An Insider's Guide.
sections.why_notable: A durable learning resource is outperforming many new projects.

sections.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
sections.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, using self-contained HTML and SVG.
sections.why_notable: Agent-assisted visual communication is emerging as a distinct tool category.

sections.title: freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2
sections.description: A prompt-as-code library and casebook for GPT Image 2 and 2.5.
sections.why_notable: Generative-image workflows are moving toward reusable, recorded recipes.

sections.title: armory3d/armorpaint
sections.why_notable: A smaller but notable return of interest in native creative tooling.

sections.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
sections.description: An MIT AI gateway with hundreds of providers and models, plus quota-aware fallback and agent protocols.
sections.why_notable: The infrastructure layer around multi-provider AI is consolidating.

sections.title: JustVugg/colibri
sections.description: A pure-C engine for running frontier mixture-of-experts models on existing hardware.
sections.why_notable: Efficient local inference is extending beyond conventional runtimes.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agentic developer workflows; AI infrastructure and local inference; applied AI in trading and image generation. Languages: TypeScript 4, JavaScript 2, C 2, and one each of Python, Shell, Rust, HTML, plus one N/A.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The list is unusually centered on agent operating practices rather than standalone model releases, with a parallel signal for local inference.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: GitHub is showing an ecosystem forming around AI agents: workflows, interfaces, routing, and operational safeguards. Local execution remains a practical counterweight to hosted-model enthusiasm.
